page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable review directives. Attach a skill to any agent — it becomes a block in that agent's prompt.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Create a skill from scratch or import one from a markdown file or archive.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

create.title: Create skill
create.subtitle: A skill is a reusable markdown directive appended to an agent's prompt.

fields.name: Name
fields.descriptionHint: The skill's interface — phrase it as a directive ("Flag …", "Hold every finding to …").
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: Flag stray console.log calls in added lines.
fields.bodyHint: Appended to the agent's prompt as a block. Keep it directive and self-contained.

import.title: Import a skill
import.subtitle: Upload a markdown file or a .zip archive — you confirm before anything is saved
import.untrustedNotice: An imported skill is someone else's instructions in your agent's prompt. It is saved disabled, marked untrusted, and its body is delimiter-wrapped as data — vet it before enabling.
import.skippedTitle: Skipped archive entries (never read or executed)

fields.name: Skill name
fields.descriptionHint: The skill's interface — phrase it as a directive.

import.success: Imported "{name}" — disabled until you vet and enable it.

preview.deleteConfirm: Delete skill "{name}"? Agents using it will lose this prompt block.
preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.descriptionHint: The skill's interface — phrase it as a directive.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
